email.subject: AI for Law Office of Kathryn Fitzgerald, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kathryn,

I noticed your practice is based in Melville, and you're navigating the demands of solo or small-team legal work in New York. That's exactly the environment where AI can make the biggest difference.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now reaching out to regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
